readLogFile: read a binary log file with struct format strings and alignment byte delimiters into a list of records
run_quadruped_playback: run a pybullet simulation that replays recorded quadruped joint positions from a binary log file
setJointMotorControl2: set joint motor control on a pybullet quadruped body using position control with target positions from log records
getJointInfo: get joint information for a pybullet quadruped body and map joint names to their numeric IDs
stepSimulation: step the pybullet physics simulation forward after setting joint positions and gravity for each log record
